elementsGroups.name: Movement
elementsGroups.description: You can move at any time during your turn (before, after, or during actions).

elementsGroups.name: Action
elementsGroups.description: You can also interact with one object or feature of the environment for free.

elementsGroups.name: Bonus Action
elementsGroups.description: You can take a bonus action only when a special ability, spell, or feature states that you can do something as a bonus action.

elementsGroups.name: Reaction
elementsGroups.description: A reaction is an instant response to a trigger of some kind, which can occur on your turn or on someone else's.

elementsGroups.name: Condition
elementsGroups.description: Conditions alter your capabilities in a variety of ways, and can arise as a result of a spell, a class feature, a monster's attack, or other effect.
